---
title: "AI Agents with M365 Copilot"
---

{{< embed agents_banner.qmd >}}

Agents are a feature of Microsoft 365 Copilot which allow you to combine Copilot's AI models with customised context and constraints. With UQ's standard licence, you can create your own agents for domain-specific conversations. Agents can create their own Microsoft Office files (Word/Excel/PowerPoint), code and images, and have access to the internet.

We have three closely related training sessions for understanding and implementing M365 Copilot's AI Agents. Each follows the same structure, with a common introduction detailing the features of M365 Copilot's Agents followed by context-specific examples.

* Workshop for [**students**](https://github.com/uqlibrary/technology-training-assets/raw/master/GenAI/AI_Agents_with_M365_Copilot_students.pdf)
* Workshop for [**professional staff**](https://github.com/uqlibrary/technology-training-assets/raw/master/GenAI/AI_Agents_with_M365_Copilot_professional_staff.pdf)
* Workshop for [**researchers**](https://github.com/uqlibrary/technology-training-assets/raw/master/GenAI/AI_Agents_with_M365_Copilot_researchers.pdf)
